Who won the 2026 Chevron Championship golf tournament in Houston in April 2026?

[2026 Chevron Championship] The 2026 Chevron Championship was the 55th Chevron Championship, an LPGA golf tournament held April 23–26 at Memorial Park Golf Course in Houston, Texas. The tournament was in its fifth year with Chevron Corporation as the title sponsor and its 44th year as a major championship. Nelly Korda led wire-to-wire to win her second Chevron Championship and third major. The win also propelled her to the number one world ranking. | other articles: Chevron Championship, 2026 in sports

Nelly Korda won the 2026 Chevron Championship, marking her second victory at this tournament and her third major overall. This win also elevated her to the number one world ranking in women's golf. 

FINAL: Nelly Korda
